nodes.label: Claude eight EwE import tables
nodes.rationale: Basic_input, Diet_composition, Landings, Discards, Detritus_fate, Biomass_accumulation, TL and Metadata preserve the source model.

nodes.label: Claude exact functional group numbering
nodes.rationale: Group number and order coordinate every output table; changing order can shift diet columns.

nodes.label: Claude coordinate based PDF extraction
nodes.rationale: Word bounding boxes, caption and footnote review, explicit header mapping, and single-row arithmetic checks make silent column errors visible.

nodes.label: Claude prose and biomass accumulation sweep
nodes.rationale: Search prose twice and search BA before balance checks; qualitative trends do not provide numeric rates.
nodes.norm_label: claude prose and biomass accumulation sweep

nodes.label: Claude unknown value preservation
nodes.rationale: Unknown database fields remain -9999; unknown BA is not software-default zero. Derived absolute or rate counterparts are logged and habitat-area scaling is explicit.

nodes.label: Claude database JSON round trip verification
nodes.rationale: Database JSON is reconstructed from emitted import tables, so writer mistakes and manual edits are independently visible.
nodes.norm_label: claude database json round trip verification

nodes.label: Claude three mass balance verdicts
nodes.rationale: BALANCED, INDETERMINATE and NOT BALANCED distinguish failure from unknown BA. Verdicts describe the extraction and stay in reports rather than loader JSON.

nodes.label: Claude source faithful extraction principle
nodes.rationale: Preserve source precision, unknowns and provenance; never repair a reported matrix or fill a missing value to satisfy a numerical check.

nodes.label: Claude EwE defaults versus sanity ranges
nodes.rationale: Software defaults can act on blank imports, whereas sanity ranges only trigger review. Neither automatically becomes paper evidence.
nodes.norm_label: claude ewe defaults versus sanity ranges

nodes.label: Ecopath production balance equation
nodes.rationale: Production equals catch, predation, net migration, biomass accumulation and other mortality; omitted migration or accumulation can explain a residual.

nodes.label: Ecopath energy balance equation
nodes.rationale: Consumption equals production, respiration and unassimilated food, requiring positive respiration and P/Q below 1 minus GS.

nodes.label: Ecopath three of four parameter rule
nodes.rationale: Three of B, P/B, Q/B and EE are supplied and Ecopath estimates the fourth; systematic published blanks need interpretation rather than guessed values.
nodes.norm_label: ecopath three of four parameter rule

nodes.label: Other mortality rate versus calculator flow
nodes.rationale: Article M0 is a rate, while model.M0 is biomass times P/B times one minus EE; natural mortality may also include predation.
nodes.norm_label: other mortality rate versus calculator flow

nodes.label: Detritus pool and fishery flow accounting
nodes.rationale: Other mortality, unassimilated food and discards feed detritus; landings leave the system. Preserve source-specific fleet and fate allocation.
nodes.norm_label: detritus pool and fishery flow accounting

nodes.label: Polovina ECOPATH formulation
nodes.rationale: Reference identifies this origin but warns its bibliographic citations were not independently verified.

nodes.label: Christensen and Pauly Ecopath II 1992
nodes.rationale: Bibliographic details are explicitly from memory in the source and require verification before publication.

nodes.label: Christensen and Walters EwE synthesis 2004
nodes.rationale: Bibliographic details are explicitly from memory in the source and require verification before publication.

nodes.label: Per parameterisation source bundle inventory
nodes.rationale: Each distinct model receives its own source inventory; file role, model coverage, authority and page or cell location preserve provenance across formats.

nodes.label: Source authority and conflict preservation
nodes.rationale: Authority order guides investigation; disagreements retain both values and locations, and all assigned files are searched before declaring a field absent.

nodes.label: Archived source versus verified numerical use
nodes.rationale: Archived papers, selected articles, computational inputs, isolated validations and contextual citations are distinct evidence categories.
nodes.norm_label: archived source versus verified numerical use

nodes.label: Claude taxonomy to mapping evidence chain
nodes.rationale: Taxonomy.xlsx membership becomes database taxon_descr then groups_df explicit-member evidence; one source reading serves extraction and mapping.
nodes.norm_label: claude taxonomy to mapping evidence chain

nodes.label: Claude SPPR model health gate
nodes.rationale: Staged SPPR uses bounded repository wrappers. Timeouts and failures remain NaN; extraction success alone does not establish usable model health.

nodes.label: Claude extraction taxonomy SPPR mapping stages
nodes.rationale: Four model stages have separate deliverables; independent catch/TL or NPP work bypasses unrequested model stages.
nodes.norm_label: claude extraction taxonomy sppr mapping stages

nodes.label: Claude cross stage missing value semantics
nodes.rationale: Unknown model fields, blank mapping weights, Unresolved decisions and NaN SPPR cells have distinct meanings and are not numeric zero.
nodes.norm_label: claude cross stage missing value semantics

nodes.label: Claude catch tonnage coverage priority
nodes.rationale: Tonnage and taxon coverage differ; coarse labels may carry substantial PPR. A 95 percent coverage target motivates review.

nodes.label: Claude mapping evidence hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Explicit membership and synonyms outrank ecological analogues. Habitat, size, guild and TL jointly support inference; TL alone does not decide.

nodes.label: Claude source member table transcription
nodes.rationale: Capture species-to-group tables before mapping and distinguish direct, regional and inferred sources.

nodes.label: Claude mapping validation and integration
nodes.rationale: Validate complete taxa, exact model groups, weights, confidence and catch restrictions; integrate model and central workbooks only within scope.

nodes.label: Claude mapping examples are not cross region lookup tables
nodes.rationale: The historical examples had limited tonnage coverage and a stratification error; transfer their output shape rather than biological assignments.
nodes.norm_label: claude mapping examples are not cross region lookup tables

nodes.label: Historical mapping CSV contract
nodes.rationale: Original group strings are join keys; schema carries taxon, common name, classes, groups, weights, confidence, evidence and explanation. Current regional matching replaces this historical storage contract.

nodes.label: Historical fixed composite weighting bases
nodes.rationale: Original fallback used identified-catch composition, model catch, biomass, then equal shares, with weights fixed across years and full precision in Final mappings.

nodes.label: Mapping confidence and evidence codes
nodes.rationale: Confidence tiers and evidence codes must agree with resolved versus unresolved decisions; explanations identify reviewable decisive facts.

nodes.label: Membership source scope and precedence
nodes.rationale: Diet-study species are not necessarily a group inventory. Reconcile source scope before populating authoritative members; independently inspect each composite candidate.

nodes.label: Group dictionary and geographic model limits
nodes.rationale: Every group gets a dictionary row with source relationship and location; source geography and grouping prefixes constrain interpretation.
nodes.norm_label: group dictionary and geographic model limits

nodes.label: Codex extraction unknown and source boundaries
nodes.rationale: Unknown BA does not prove steady state; do not normalize source matrices or turn checker suggestions into source data.
nodes.norm_label: codex extraction unknown and source boundaries

nodes.label: Codex extraction database round trip
nodes.rationale: The complete Codex workflow rebuilds database JSON from the eight emitted files to expose conversion and editing errors.

nodes.label: Codex extraction three mass balance verdicts
nodes.rationale: The complete Codex extraction workflow preserves the distinction among balanced, indeterminate and failed extraction.
nodes.norm_label: codex extraction three mass balance verdicts

nodes.label: Codex paper to PPR stage routing
nodes.rationale: Entry routing supports paper extraction, taxonomy, SPPR, mapping and independent NPP or classic PPR without unnecessary model stages.
nodes.norm_label: codex paper to ppr stage routing

nodes.label: Codex source membership and integration boundaries
nodes.rationale: Exact membership does not settle geographic weights; methods, catch bases, source scopes and missing responses stay distinct.
nodes.norm_label: codex source membership and integration boundaries

nodes.label: Codex complete paper to PPR stage flow
nodes.rationale: Four model stages are connected by distinct artifacts and independent estimates use the integration contract.
nodes.norm_label: codex complete paper to ppr stage flow

nodes.label: Codex mapping source evidence safeguards
nodes.rationale: Membership outranks SAU classes, table scope must be reviewed, and a validation pass cannot prove ecological correctness.

nodes.label: Codex full mapping coverage and reporting
nodes.rationale: The full mapping workflow couples iterative validation, source limitations and conditional model-workbook integration.
nodes.norm_label: codex full mapping coverage and reporting

nodes.label: Atlas SPPR source scope selector
nodes.rationale: All includes imports, inner excludes imports, and PP restricts to primary-producer sources.

nodes.label: Atlas catch basis and unidentified treatment controls
nodes.rationale: Landings default, all catch and discards are separate bases; unidentified catch offers selected-method, zero-PPR and simple-chain scenarios.

nodes.label: Atlas assessed landings sensitivity envelope
nodes.rationale: Discard-routing envelopes are assessed landings scenario ranges rather than confidence intervals.

nodes.label: Atlas NPP availability and historical fill control
nodes.rationale: Actual annual data is the default; optional earliest-year backfill is exposed separately. NPP is independent of catch and model availability.

nodes.label: Atlas recycling metric controls
nodes.rationale: Map metrics include b and rho living; the SPPR_new transfer-efficiency selector exposes GE and TE with EE repair.

nodes.rationale: Multiple methods yield separate curves; selected ecosystems are summed and model versions remain separate.

nodes.label: Time series selected ecosystem versus global NPP denominator

nodes.label: Annual regional NPP integral
nodes.rationale: Annual regional tonnes C sum daily productivity times calendar-month days, spherical pixel area and polygon fraction; denominator for PPR.

nodes.label: Antoine–Morel reference product
nodes.rationale: Copernicus GlobColour monthly 4 km PP is the reference product; source document records STAC discovery, native anonymous downloads and units mg C m−2 day−1.

nodes.label: OSU MODIS R2022 algorithms
nodes.rationale: VGPM, Eppley-VGPM, CbPM2 and CAFE use the same MODIS R2022 input chain and 1/12 degree grid. Shared sensor inputs mean algorithms are not statistically independent.

nodes.label: Satellite water mask
nodes.rationale: Integration includes cells observed in any window-year month; never-observed permanent pack ice remains outside the conservative water area.

nodes.label: Hierarchical annual gap filling
nodes.rationale: Observed, polar-night zero, anomaly-rescaled pixel climatology and insolation-capped near-neighbour fill form central NPP. Far spatial fills remain separately reported upper-bound values.

nodes.label: Spherical cell area and fractional coverage
nodes.rationale: Exact cell/polygon fractions multiply spherical pixel areas; centroid membership is unsuitable along coasts; same-layer overlaps remain distinct.
nodes.norm_label: spherical cell area and fractional coverage

nodes.label: Common-mask model comparison
nodes.rationale: Algorithms share one 1/12 degree grid and jointly observed pixels for comparison; 4 km reference reduces by exact valid-cell 2×2 mean.

nodes.label: Baseline-scaled algorithm ensemble
nodes.rationale: Per-model annual estimate equals gap-filled reference baseline times common-coverage model/reference ratio. Sparse common coverage falls back to own-coverage ratios; no model retrieval remains missing, never zero.

nodes.label: Algorithm spread and shared-input uncertainty
nodes.rationale: The preserved 2019 report describes algorithm choice as dominant regional uncertainty; shared MODIS inputs mean the spread understates total uncertainty.

nodes.label: Overlapping marine region systems
nodes.rationale: LME, EEZ and high-seas areas overlap; summed region-system totals double count production. The documented recommendation is EEZ plus high-seas partition with explicit overlaps removed.

nodes.label: Optional first-order benthic production
nodes.rationale: Benthic add-on is off by default and does not affect core outputs. Shelf/light allocation has large uncertainty; mixing availability-weighted benthic with unweighted pelagic NPP mixes conventions.

nodes.label: Preserved 2019 NPP reference results
nodes.rationale: Reported 2019 totals are preserved reference results, not recalculated by this graph refresh. Later annual availability and production workflows are governed by the current annual documentation.

nodes.label: NPP configuration and shared paths
nodes.rationale: Relative raw, work and output paths resolve from the YAML file; shared data are under common_reference_data/npp. Configuration specifies 2019, its five-year window, three region layers, and the native baseline grid.

nodes.label: Central fill settings
nodes.rationale: Polar-night zero, climatology and nearest-neighbour fill are enabled; central estimate excludes far fill, near/far threshold is 200 km, and anomaly clipping is 0.5–2.0.

nodes.label: Five-algorithm ensemble configuration
nodes.rationale: Antoine–Morel is the reference among five models; 1/12 degree ensemble common-mask comparison uses a 5% water-area threshold before fallback.

nodes.label: 2019 preserved NPP summary
nodes.rationale: Preserved gap-filled Antoine–Morel central totals: LMEs 18.49, high seas 24.63, EEZs 27.82 Pg C/yr. These overlapping systems cannot be added. Reference output lists per-model spreads and limited-model regions.

nodes.rationale: NumPy/Pandas/SciPy numerics; NetCDF4/HDF4 satellite readers; Shapely/GeoPandas/exactextract/pyproj geometry; openpyxl workbooks; YAML configuration; Certifi trust and pytest tests.

nodes.label: Tested Windows dependency lock
nodes.rationale: Dependency versions are a preserved tested Windows Python 3.13 environment; package installation with --no-deps follows the lock.
